hint_fr: Si vous poussez le pion maintenant, le roi noir vient se planter devant lui et c'est nulle. Votre roi doit passer devant son pion — et pour passer, il lui faut l'opposition. Les rois se font face aussi en diagonale.
hint_en: Push the pawn now and Black's king parks in front of it: draw. Your king has to lead the way, and to get past it needs the opposition. Kings can face each other diagonally, too.

claims.note: Syzygy tablebase (tablebase.lichess.ovh), checked 2026-10-08: Kd5 is the ONLY winning move. e5 and the seven other king moves all draw. Checked for every legal move, not sampled.
